source: Mees et al. 2022 (RA-L, arXiv:2112.03227), task success-condition table; mirrors calvin_env Tasks.get_task_info() state-delta checks.
semantics: Each predicate is a DETERMINISTIC function of recorded scene state, evaluated as a delta between the first recorded frame (start_info) and last recorded frame (end_info) of a window. 'continuous_delta' predicates threshold a scalar change; 'binary_state' predicates require a recorded boolean to flip. No learned model is involved. This is the Tier-1 floor for the embodied adapter.
frozen_variable: acceptance-predicate definitions v1 (versioned like code; changing any threshold is a new predicate-set version)

rotate_red_block_right.condition: delta euler_z <= -60deg (clockwise) AND |delta euler_x|<30deg AND |delta euler_y|<30deg
rotate_red_block_right.authorizes: orientation change about z of the named block only

rotate_red_block_left.condition: delta euler_z >= +60deg (counter-clockwise) AND |delta euler_x|<30deg AND |delta euler_y|<30deg
rotate_red_block_left.authorizes: orientation change about z of the named block only

rotate_blue_block_right.condition: delta euler_z <= -60deg AND |delta euler_x|<30deg AND |delta euler_y|<30deg
rotate_blue_block_right.authorizes: orientation change about z of the named block only

rotate_blue_block_left.condition: delta euler_z >= +60deg AND |delta euler_x|<30deg AND |delta euler_y|<30deg
rotate_blue_block_left.authorizes: orientation change about z of the named block only

rotate_pink_block_right.condition: delta euler_z <= -60deg AND |delta euler_x|<30deg AND |delta euler_y|<30deg
rotate_pink_block_right.authorizes: orientation change about z of the named block only

rotate_pink_block_left.condition: delta euler_z >= +60deg AND |delta euler_x|<30deg AND |delta euler_y|<30deg
rotate_pink_block_left.authorizes: orientation change about z of the named block only

push_red_block_right.condition: delta pos_x >= +0.10m AND surface_contact in both frames
push_red_block_right.authorizes: planar translation of the named block along +x

push_red_block_left.condition: delta pos_x <= -0.10m AND surface_contact in both frames
push_red_block_left.authorizes: planar translation of the named block along -x

push_blue_block_right.condition: delta pos_x >= +0.10m AND surface_contact in both frames
push_blue_block_right.authorizes: planar translation of the named block along +x

push_blue_block_left.condition: delta pos_x <= -0.10m AND surface_contact in both frames
push_blue_block_left.authorizes: planar translation of the named block along -x

push_pink_block_right.condition: delta pos_x >= +0.10m AND surface_contact in both frames
push_pink_block_right.authorizes: planar translation of the named block along +x

push_pink_block_left.condition: delta pos_x <= -0.10m AND surface_contact in both frames
push_pink_block_left.authorizes: planar translation of the named block along -x

lift_red_block_table.condition: delta pos_z >= +0.05m AND gripper NOT touching block in start frame
lift_red_block_table.authorizes: vertical displacement of the named block from the table

lift_blue_block_table.condition: delta pos_z >= +0.05m AND gripper NOT touching block in start frame
lift_blue_block_table.authorizes: vertical displacement of the named block from the table

lift_pink_block_table.condition: delta pos_z >= +0.05m AND gripper NOT touching block in start frame
lift_pink_block_table.authorizes: vertical displacement of the named block from the table

lift_red_block_slider.condition: delta pos_z >= +0.03m from slider surface AND gripper NOT touching block in start frame
lift_red_block_slider.authorizes: vertical displacement of the named block from the slider

lift_blue_block_slider.condition: delta pos_z >= +0.03m from slider surface AND gripper NOT touching block in start frame
lift_blue_block_slider.authorizes: vertical displacement of the named block from the slider

lift_pink_block_slider.condition: delta pos_z >= +0.03m from slider surface AND gripper NOT touching block in start frame
lift_pink_block_slider.authorizes: vertical displacement of the named block from the slider

lift_red_block_drawer.condition: delta pos_z >= +0.05m from drawer surface AND gripper NOT touching block in start frame
lift_red_block_drawer.authorizes: vertical displacement of the named block from the drawer

lift_blue_block_drawer.condition: delta pos_z >= +0.05m from drawer surface AND gripper NOT touching block in start frame
lift_blue_block_drawer.authorizes: vertical displacement of the named block from the drawer

lift_pink_block_drawer.condition: delta pos_z >= +0.05m from drawer surface AND gripper NOT touching block in start frame
lift_pink_block_drawer.authorizes: vertical displacement of the named block from the drawer

place_in_slider.condition: block final pos inside slider region AND gripper WAS holding block in start frame
place_in_slider.authorizes: transport of held block into slider region

place_in_drawer.condition: block final pos inside drawer region AND gripper WAS holding block in start frame
place_in_drawer.authorizes: transport of held block into drawer region

push_into_drawer.condition: block final pos inside drawer region AND block touched table in start frame
push_into_drawer.authorizes: planar push of a block into drawer region

stack_block.condition: one block final pos directly above another (stacked) AND not contacting gripper in final frame
stack_block.authorizes: vertical placement of one block onto another

unstack_block.condition: previously-stacked top block removed from atop the other AND not contacting gripper in start frame
unstack_block.authorizes: removal of top block from a stack

turn_on_lightbulb.authorizes: lightbulb binary state change via switch

turn_off_lightbulb.authorizes: lightbulb binary state change via switch

turn_on_led.authorizes: led binary state change via button

turn_off_led.authorizes: led binary state change via button
